findings.problem: Blackhole drops every receive error and skips a poisoned observation lock. Existing nonzero counters can remain stale and satisfy later unchanged-count/one-attempt assertions after unexpected observer failure.
findings.fix: Retain and surface the first unexpected receive/lock failure. Permit only explicitly justified transient cases; every count/stability observation must check observer health.
findings.cause: datagrams1596-1598 returns a bare atomic count and receive branch only handles Ok; no observer failure state is populated for Err. connection_attempts checks parse errors/poison on its own read but does not repair other count-only observations.
findings.reproduction_plan: After an independently observed real positive datagram, inject a typed observer/receive failure and prove a subsequent quiet/count observation errors rather than returning the earlier count. Distinct explicit transient positive control if retained.
findings.runtime_status: Source-supported error-oracle gap; no observed OS failure, poisoned-lock event or runtime reproduction is claimed.
findings.disposition: New finding separate from A73-A76. Root notified for bounded remediation.

contracts: Pending-handshake controls poll the actual request concurrently until server replies are observed at a relay that never forwards replies; they reject premature request completion, require failures0/active1, keep peers/runtime alive, then observe active0 and real socket bind after Drop/Finish.
Finish is an owned error-observing join. Drop is cancellation scheduling plus endpoint close, not synchronous join; runtime control must establish eventual release.

Literal invariant headers are an independent bounded observer oracle, not authenticated QUIC packets. Initial IDs/source/version are bounded before copying; malformed observations are retained and returned by connection_attempts.

Three original regression assertions require old behavior to fail rather than documenting defective behavior as success. Two added identity/header controls and one Finish control expand final coverage.
Same-time two live UDP sockets cannot share the exact local SocketAddr in the literal second-source positive, unlike sequential ephemeral-port uniqueness assumption removed from real attempts.
Domain helpers and child control module have concrete responsibilities; no production/network API, arbitrary resource caps or protocol behavior changed.
limitations: Blackhole receive/lock error masking is not exempt merely because inherited; new finding above remains distinct from approved four.
Random CID uniqueness and fixed v1/v2 interpretation are bounded current fixture assumptions; no arbitrary-version/public parser or hostile-peer support guarantee.
Only the first invariant packet header is observed, not authenticated payload or all coalesced packet contents.
macOS ReservedPort deliberately releases the port, so no universal held-port guarantee; Windows/Linux socket ownership is established by helper source.

Underlying Connecting Err(_) remains a handshake-failed counter rather than exact certificate-failure classification; actual pending-handshake controls additionally require server replies and zero failures.
Partial caller/dependency ranges are not whole lifecycle audit or final1845-line full-read credit.
